subjects.name: ポケットモンスター サン＆ムーン

summary:
莉莉艾是宝可梦 太阳＆月亮的女主角之一，她是位于阿罗拉地区美乐美乐岛的宝可梦学校的学生，小智的同班同学。她是以太基金会的大小姐，对于宝可梦的知识上是全班No.1。在宝可梦 太阳＆月亮的阿罗拉联盟宣传视频中，她被称为阿罗拉绽放的冰之花（日文︰アローラに咲く氷の花）。

莉莉艾是一个性格认真、彬彬有礼的女孩。她喜爱宝可梦，但是因为小时候曾经被ＵＢ０１：寄生物袭击过的关系，她不敢接近它们，一旦被宝可梦触摸或是看到宝可梦在附近，她会感到不适并跳开或是直接“石化”在原地。不过在谁是蛋的照顾者？，莉莉艾成功克服不敢触摸宝可梦的蛋的恐惧，尽管她还是不敢触碰其他宝可梦，之后在莉莉艾，要好好疼爱皮卡丘哦中她也可以触碰皮卡丘了，在发现宝物！长毛狗搜寻!!中她还可以不穿防护服骑乘长毛狗，而在莉莉艾与银伴战兽，苏醒的记忆中她解开了幼年时的心结终于可以正常接触宝可梦。为了避免接触到宝可梦，她甚至会通过穿着十分厚重的隔离防护服来获得安全感。当其他人指出她对宝可梦的恐惧时，莉莉艾总是否认这一点并表示她只是有意识的选择避开宝可梦而已，并且这种躲避行为不影响她对宝可梦的热爱。虽然她不敢接近宝可梦，但是只要宝可梦在安全距离外，她就能适应并接受，为此管家詹姆斯在家中设置了一个乐园，让她隔着玻璃看到宝可梦在那里玩耍。尽管如此，莉莉艾拥有丰富的宝可梦理论知识并热爱学习，她了解不同的宝可梦的行为习惯、属性、形态变化，她甚至了解传说的宝可梦，美乐美乐岛的守护神卡璞・鸣鸣的基本资料，在小心铲子!!!中她也凭借这一点想出了一个周全的计划救出了小智和火斑喵以及洛托姆图鉴。此外，她的房间里有许多宝可梦的玩偶，入睡时也会带着皮皮玩偶。

她对周遭事物的观察也非常仔细，在阿罗拉侦探洛托姆！消失的纯晶之谜!!中，小智因为电Ｚ丢了非常焦急，又听说卡奇会因此生气而感到害怕。莉莉艾挺身而出帮他打掩护，而随后在洛托姆图鉴说卡奇是拿走纯晶的人时，莉莉艾又凭借自己的细心发现了洛托姆图鉴的视频资料中的一些细节，证明了他的清白。

莉莉艾一开始对自己的妈妈露莎米奈喜欢擅作主张很不满，对于妈妈称自己为小宝宝觉得反感，但实际是对于妈妈不能像以前一样经常陪伴自己而感到寂寞，内心其实非常关心自己的妈妈，尤其在露莎米奈被ＵＢ０１：寄生物掳走及寄生后她的所作所为都可以证明这一点。另外，她很关心哥哥格拉吉欧，在她见不到哥哥的时候，会试图从小智那里打听哥哥的消息。在露莎米奈被ＵＢ０１：寄生物掳走后的一系列事件中，可以看出虽然外表有些柔弱，但是莉莉艾内心很坚强，也非常有勇气去面对突如其来的变故。

莉莉艾与小光非常相似，都是有时显得过分自信，高估自己的能力。在谁是蛋的照顾者？中，当莉莉艾表示有决心就能触碰宝可梦时，却被水莲反驳她自从来到学校后便没有触碰它们。在莉莉艾与银伴战兽，苏醒的记忆中，由于莉莉艾在之前遇上了属性：空，她再次受到惊吓，导致她不能再次触碰包括白滚滚在内的宝可梦。为了能再次与宝可梦触碰，莉莉艾声称自己在触碰宝可梦方面没问题，并要求白滚滚跳上她身上，让她再次触碰，结果莉莉艾马上被吓倒，使同学们略为失望。芭内特博士形容她有点逞强，但仍称赞她做出一个勇敢的尝试。在飞吧攀登吧，垒磊石！中，莉莉艾与同学们在操场上玩跳箱游戏，她声称在跳之前已练习过，应该没问题，但最后还是落于跳箱的顶部，没能成功跳越，她为此而感到很不好意思。

summary:
玛奥是《太阳／月亮》中登场人物。她是阿卡拉岛树荫丛林的队长，精通草属性。

玛奥初次登场于《太阳／月亮》，是诸岛巡礼的队长之一。她是一名热情开朗的厨师，她喜欢烹饪而且水平不错，但是有些时候她烹饪的品味会变得十分奇特。

在诸岛巡礼中，主角需要前往树荫丛林，玛奥在那里主持考验。玛奥给了主角材料袋，并让主角去寻找四/三份指定的食材。在主角找到相应的食材后，玛奥叫来了水莲和卡奇，并在主角的帮助下制作成了名为玛奥特制（日文︰マオスペシャル，英文︰The Mallow Special）的特别料理，从而引来了霸主宝可梦兰螳花。在《太阳／月亮》中主角击败兰螳花后，水莲和卡奇非常期待的品尝了玛奥的特制大餐，因为其难以形容的口感而逃离了丛林。而到了《究极之日／究极之月》二人则直接推托说这份料理符合丽姿的口味。

在游戏中玛奥的口头禅是谢谢惠顾（日文︰まいどどーも，英文︰Thanks for stopping by）。

찬란하게 빛나는 금발과 반짝이는 벚꽃색 눈동자, 너무나도 사랑스러운 외모이지만 속은 모든 게임이란 게임에는 다 통달한 게이머의 영혼이 들어가 있다. 난이도 최악의 게임 세계관이지만 그녀가 여태 깨지 못한 게임은 없었다. 그러니 이번에도 해피엔딩을 보기위해 불도저처럼 직진한다.

“不要看，不要听，然后忘掉吧……有些事情，还是不知道比较幸福。”——达妮娅

档案资料>>
星炬学院虚质科学部学生达妮娅，总对大家展露出“温柔”的微笑，偶尔也会说上几句俏皮话。
她经常懒懒地打盹，静静地观察与自己一起生活的人们，那些热闹真切的笑容让她感到温暖安心。

异能力>>泡影视阈
达妮娅挥动一柄造型华丽的手杖，泡泡随之释放出来。
这些泡泡有着一定的虚质防护作用，看似柔软轻盈，却只轻轻一漾，便能将敌人困在梦幻星穹之中。

우여곡절 끝에 R41 차원에서 건너온 아멜리아.
냉혹한 군주가 아닌, 하나의 엘프로서 새로운 차원에 빠르게 적응하고 있다.
가끔 놀라울 정도의 자기애를 보여주어 주변 사도들을 당황하게 만들 때가 있다.

作为普通小学生，他因意外卷入未来科技纷争，性格善良勇敢且富有正义感。通过变身装置掌握火星大力拳、超电磁光子炮等必杀技，先后击败野心科学家派遣的机器人路比与时空海盗“四圣团”。在第三部中，其初代变身表损毁后获得新型装备，配备电击风火轮、降龙剑等六件电击武装，战力全面提升。冒险过程中与伙伴共同成长，逐渐理解责任与勇气的意义。
角色造型辨识度极高，黑色短发搭配闪电标识，变身后战衣以红白闪电图案为主体，武器包含闪电状天线刀刃等未来科技装备。其双重形象——日常憨态与战斗英姿的反差，成为动画标志性设计之一。

The Protagonist was created as nothing more than a clone inside of Heaven with the sole purpose of being used as spare parts for his template BOSS in case any of his cybernetics or biological functions began to fail. However, PUPPY also represented a security flaw in the system, as his identical genetics to BOSS meant that he HEAVEN's automated security would allow him to pass through most defenses untouched. His existence would change when a coup was hatched by the the top executives of HEAVEN who wished to kill the BOSS and take control. A low level employee named Wizard hacked into PUPPY and convinced him that he needed to "KILL BOSS", under the idea that Wizard had taken the protagonist's little brother hostage and was forcing him to carry out these acts.

The Protagonis would come very close to succeeding in his original task, coming face with Head of Heaven HQ Security Chief Watayama after having traversed through the facility and managed to dispatch of the security director and his goons and was about to break into the door to BOSS's office when suddenly he was electrocuted and knocked unconscious when HER managed to overpower Wizard for control of PUPPY.

Having ended up in Rengkok South, the protagonist would be saved by the Mechanix and later contacted by HER and instructed on how to save his captured brother, although in truth she was using him to track down all those whom had betrayed BOSS. First the protagonist was sent through to the Creep's Parking Garage where he fought through the hordes of gang members in order to track Wizard down. He kills Nerve, Donvius and Jurek in the process before finding Wizard and allowing HER to fry him to death and take his memory chip.

Next was to track down the protagonists lost brother using a tracker HER claimed to have on him, which led the duo to the industrialized roots of Rengkok known as the Hanza Compound where the protagonist had to fight through Techno Dogs, and defeat the bloodthirsty A.I. known as Mother and her "children" known as Angel and killing Captain Bogdan, Hongshi, and Shadow before finally finding and confronting TrafficKing and after being chased by him, the protagonist managed to turn the tables and defeat him and allow HER to hack into TrafficKIng and knocking him out.

The protagonist dragged the corpulent company man back to the Mechanix who wired him to be obedient only to the protagonist and HER and gave the protagonist the options to be able to electrecute him if need be. With him in tow the protagonist made his way to the deepest part of the city, the Imagination Farms where Hosts are kept in containment pods as they work in the virtuality business, a place also known as HELL. Unfortunately for them, as the protagonist and HER learn, these people often end up loosing their sense of selves and become Drained Hosts, zombie like entities barely passing for a living creature. The protagonist cut his way through the Hosts and the defenctive Angels, and cut down Khog and seemingly kill TrafficKing in the process before finally reaching Mother again as well as battling a remade and reanimated TrafficKing who is soundly defeated by the protagonist before he confronts the Sick Sisters. 

The protagonist discovers they were in charge of these ruthless acts and engages them by battling Mother who acts as their transport and after an intense battle the protagonist managed to kill both of the sisters as well as destroying Mother for good. Finally with the last of the people who tried to betray BOSS dead, he opens the containment pod that he thinks his brother is inside, but instead has a hallucination and apparently shuts down, unconscious. When he awakens, he has been brought to HEAVEN, shackled, and BOSS is in front of him.

It is there that the protagonist discovers that he was never his own person and the Brother he was hoping to save never existed, he was nothing but a puppet that had been used by various parties for their own goals, continuously manipulated with false memories and manufactured motivations. He was originally created as a clone of BOSS merely as organ donation spare parts. BOSS' traitorous executives had come up with a plan to use the protagonist as an assassin to try to kill BOSS, taking advantage of the protagonist's identical biometrics to BOSS to bypass automated security; HER had made a deal with BOSS to use the protagonist to sniff out the traitors and destroy them instead. However, HER had plans of her own, and used him to first destroy all the other traitorous leaders of HEAVEN to gain BOSS' trust, but finally revealing her true plans by releasing the protagonist's shackles right in front of BOSS and ordering the protagonist to kill the leader as well (therefore destroying HEAVEN). BOSS, akathe protagonist's template confirms this to the protagonist before ordering his guards to killthe protagonist. BOSS sent everything he had at his clone, putting a veritable army of elite forces in his way, but ultimately his security was defeated and the protagonist either electrocutes BOSS or bludgeons him to death with a steel pipe before going to meet HER at an as of yet unspecified location, now finally "free" thanks to HER.
